_comment: Spans in which a club existed on paper but fielded no senior side, so its
absence from the tables is a fact about the club rather than a hole in the
data. Seasons listed here are drawn as plain background, like the seasons
before a club was founded or after it folded - not as the dotted 'no
position recorded' mark, which would claim the record is missing.
Only interior spans need an entry. A club's seasons before its first
recorded one and after its last are handled automatically by render.py,
which is what covers the clubs that simply folded: Hakoah Tel Aviv merged
into Hakoah Maccabi Ramat Gan, and Hapoel Yehud and Maccabi Rehovot are
written up in the past tense.
'from'/'to' are the calendar years a season started, inclusive.

Shimshon Tel Aviv.reason: Merged with Beitar Tel Aviv in 2000 as Beitar Shimshon Tel Aviv; Shimshon left the merger in 2011 and only re-formed a senior team in 2014. The merged club's seasons are recorded under Beitar Tel Aviv.
